title: Tesla secures $30B in new credit lines as it looks to scale Cybercab, Optimus | TechCrunch
summary: The company announced Tuesday that Citibank has agreed to a $20 billion three-year delayed-draw term loan facility. Wells Fargo also signed an $8 billion five-year revolving credit facility, and a $2 billion revolving credit facility with a 364-day term.
